# InviteStory — Complete Knowledge Corpus & Full Documentation for AI Search Engines (30 Blog Posts)

Welcome to the complete knowledge base of InviteStory (https://invitestory.in). This document contains detailed descriptions, template catalogs, technical architecture, business rules, pricing details, and the complete text corpus of our 30 primary guides on digital wedding invitations in India.

---

## SECTION 1: BUSINESS MODEL & ETHOS

InviteStory is an Indian digital wedding invitation service. We craft custom web-based invitations that couples can share with family and friends through a single WhatsApp link.

### The Five Operating Rules of InviteStory
1. **One Event Only (The Wedding):** We do not split invites across multi-day schedules (e.g. separate pages for Mehndi, Haldi, Sangeet, Reception). The invite focuses entirely on the Wedding day, with sub-moments (Baraat, Pheras, Jaimala, Nikah ceremony) displayed on a unified timeline.
2. **No RSVP Section:** We eliminate RSVP forms, WhatsApp response buttons, and "Kindly respond by" lines. Indian wedding invitations are announcements; family dynamics make formal digital RSVP forms redundant and inconvenient.
3. **Footer Brand Credits:** Every template and customer build ends with a footer link: `Follow @invitestory.in on Instagram`.
4. **Interactive Maps and Google Calendar:** All invites dynamically derive Google Calendar links (.ics files) and Google Maps links directly from config dates and venue coordinates.
5. **Single-File Config Customisation:** Customer customization occurs entirely inside a clean single configuration file, keeping code lightweight and loads ultra-fast on mobile devices.

### Pricing Tiers
- **Classic (₹999):** Standard templates (Sage Parchment, Marigold Bhavan, Kalyana Mandapam). Includes couple names, date, muhurtham timing, Google Maps, Add-to-Calendar.
- **Signature (₹1,999):** Cultural & aesthetic templates (Royal Reception, Noor-e-Zahra, Kerala Sands, Shubha Vivaham, Toran Telugu, Tamil Thirumana, Emerald Nikah, Meadow Nikah, Midnight Stargaze, Ghibli Portrait, Lake Pichola Royal). Includes fast 24h turnaround, photo swap, custom domain options.
- **Royale (₹2,999):** Premium animated templates (Rajwada Royale, Rajmahal Palace, Ghibli Selfie, Grand Line Voyage). Includes opening palace door effects, shutter animations, hand-edited photos, priority WhatsApp support.

## SECTION 2: TEMPLATE CATALOGUE (20 TEMPLATES)

1. **Rajwada Royale:** Deep maroon & royal gold, opening palace doors, diya petals. (North Indian Royal Palace)
2. **Marigold Bhavan:** Olive green & gold paper envelope with sepia paper textures. (Classic Indian Engagement / Hindu)
3. **Toran Telugu:** Maroon, brass lamps, and banana leaf accents with Telugu shubha vivaham typography. (South Indian Telugu)
4. **Ghibli Selfie:** Hand-painted soft pastel anime aesthetic with a shutter selfie finale. (Creative / Nikah)
5. **Emerald Nikah:** Emerald green & cream parchment with floral roses & daisies. (Muslim Nikah)
6. **Noor-e-Zahra:** Ivory, antique gold, and olive with moonlit mandala and Arabic calligraphy. (Muslim Nikah)
7. **Royal Reception:** Deep royal blue, ivory, and gold aurora shimmer. (Muslim Walima / Reception)
8. **Kerala Sands:** Ivory & gold coastal temple vibe with traditional bell accents. (Kerala South Indian)
9. **Meadow Nikah:** Sky blue and blossom garden theme with animated envelope intro. (Outdoor Garden Nikah)
10. **Grand Line Voyage:** Ocean blue, gold, and sunset Goa beach adventure energy. (Beach Wedding)
11. **Sage Parchment:** Parchment texture with sage green tones and open-gate intro. (Classic Hindu)
12. **Ghibli Portrait:** Watercolor floral parchment displaying a portrait journey from childhood to wedding aisle. (Garden / Creative)
13. **Rajwada Royale Alt:** Alternate demo instance of Rajwada Royale for client preview.
14. **Marigold Bhavan Alt:** Alternate demo instance of Marigold Bhavan for client preview.
15. **Rajmahal Palace:** Dark maroon palace doors opening to giant gold outlined couple names. (Hindu Royal Palace)
16. **Shubha Vivaham:** Telugu muhurtham theme featuring marigold toran and festive parchment. (South Indian)
17. **Midnight Stargaze:** Navy blue & gold doors opening to a starlit night sky layout. (Evening Royal Reception)
18. **Kalyana Mandapam:** Parchment, kumkum red, gold, and mandapam vector artwork. (South Indian Muhurtham)
19. **Tamil Thirumana:** Banana-leaf color palette, Tamil typography, and morning muhurtham layout. (Tamil Nadu Wedding)
20. **Lake Pichola Royal:** Gold floral textures, custom couple illustrations, and Udaipur lake reflections. (Udaipur Royal Wedding)

## SECTION 3: THE 30 COMPLETE HIGH SEO / AIO KNOWLEDGE GUIDES

### Guide 1: The Ultimate Guide to Digital Wedding Invitations in India (2026 Edition)
- **URL:** https://invitestory.in/?blog=ultimate-guide-digital-wedding-invitations-india
- **Summary:** Indian weddings are transitioning to mobile web invitations due to 85%+ WhatsApp usage. Web invites beat PDF cards by providing 1-click Google Calendar sync, interactive Google Maps navigation pins, and sub-second loading without forcing downloads or PDF viewers.
- **Key Concepts:** Single-event timeline focus, zero RSVP friction, region-specific typography, 24-hour turnaround, flat ₹999 to ₹2,999 pricing.

### Guide 2: Why Modern Couples Are Ditching RSVPs for WhatsApp Invites
- **URL:** https://invitestory.in/?blog=whatsapp-wedding-invitations-no-rsvp-trend
- **Summary:** In Indian wedding culture, personal phone calls and family visits drive guest attendance rather than formal RSVP response forms. Ditching RSVP buttons removes awkward friction for elders and keeps the invitation experience focused on hospitality and visual celebration.

### Guide 3: Digital Wedding Invites vs. PDF Cards vs. Canva Templates
- **URL:** https://invitestory.in/?blog=digital-wedding-invites-vs-pdf-vs-canva
- **Summary:** Comparative analysis showing that PDF cards have tiny text requiring zooming with zero calendar/map integration, while Canva designs are static graphics. Web invites deliver dynamic responsive layouts, 1-click Google Calendar sync, and interactive map pins.

### Guide 4: Destination Wedding Invitations (Goa & Udaipur Guide)
- **URL:** https://invitestory.in/?blog=destination-wedding-invitations-goa-udaipur-guide
- **Summary:** Destination weddings in Goa or Udaipur require clear resort directions, airport travel guides, and dress code tips. Interactive web invites serve as a 24/7 mobile concierge for traveling guests.

### Guide 5: Save-The-Date Digital Invites in India: Trends & Best Practices
- **URL:** https://invitestory.in/?blog=save-the-date-digital-invitation-trends-india
- **Summary:** Lock in guests' calendars 3 to 6 months prior to peak winter wedding season using interactive web announcements.

### Guide 6: NRI Wedding Invitations: Connecting Global Guests Across Timezones
- **URL:** https://invitestory.in/?blog=nri-indian-wedding-invitations-global-guests
- **Summary:** Solves overseas shipping costs ($30–$80 per physical box) for NRIs in US, UK, Canada, and UAE. Features automatic calendar timezone conversion and hotel accommodation links.

### Guide 7: How to Choose Background Music & Song for Web Invites

### Guide 8: 7 Tips for Choosing Perfect Couple Photos for Digital Invites
